title: upstream: cddl-rs rejects choice-typed map keys
description: cddl crate 0.10.7 rejects map entries whose key is a type choice (mimi-content A.1: '* unknownExtension' with 'name = int / tstr .size (1..255)'): integer keys -> 'unexpected key', text keys -> 'map requires entry key of type int'. Also default-features=false + cbor fails to compile (needs json, additional-controls, ast-span). Repro CDDL and CBOR in the 2.6 spike notes. Report upstream only with Mark's per-action OK.
